about: Q's patch file (build 112): hand-voiced instruments for the Q synth in place of the ROM's.
The chip always plays the ROM's. Read once at start-up; restart the game after an edit.
PATCHES on the AUDIO page (Escape, AUDIO) switches the whole file on or off.
An entry names its instrument by the bank's number (cfEF's byte) and says only what it changes;
a field left out keeps the ROM's value. tools/q_patch_template.py N writes instrument N whole.
Operators are the chip's 1-4. multiple 0-15 (0 = a half), detune -3..3, level 0-127
(0.75 dB a step, 0 loudest; the song's volume is still added on carriers), key_scale 0-3,
attack/decay/sustain_rate 0-31, sustain_level/release 0-15. Q only: fine_cents per operator,
volume_db per instrument, tail: row (as TAILS), fade or ring. 'role' is a note, not read.
docs/audio.md, 'The patch file', has the rest.
